messages:
arjun: FYI I'll be primary oncall tomorrow 06:00-14:00 UTC. Planning a quick change: route low-priority cpu-usage alerts (non-prod) to #eng-oncall-delayed for quiet hours to reduce noise. Will post planned config and rollback steps.

maria: what's 'low-priority' exactly? threshold? which services? worried about missing a real issue.

arjun: low-priority = alert.metadata.priority == "low" AND alert.target == "non-prod". current cpu threshold 70% for those. proposal: keep threshold, only change routing to delayed channel for 06:00-10:00 UTC; for 10:00-14:00 route normal. No threshold change unless we see missed escalations.

kevin: i prefer not touching thresholds for now. routing only is safe. can we throttle duplicate alerts? we've seen floods from batch jobs.

sylvie: agree routing-only. add a small dedupe window (5m) and ensure the runbook gets an obvious escalate if error-rate rises. also add an automatic revert at 14:00.

arjun: plan below (will apply at 06:00 UTC):
```yaml
routing: 
  - match: "alert.labels.priority == 'low' and env == 'non-prod' and time in 06:00-10:00"
    route: "#eng-oncall-delayed"
    dedupe_window: "5m"
  - fallback: "#eng-oncall"
```
Rollback: remove above rules or set route back to #eng-oncall. I'll keep monitoring.

oncall-bot: Deploy scheduled by arjun at 1752003800. Change will be applied in 10m window and auto-revert at 1752007200 if not manually removed.

maria: can we add an alert that escalates to paging if SLO_error_rate > 0.5% in 15m? wanna make sure we still page if something serious.

kevin: I'll volunteer as backup for the 06:00-10:00 window. ping me if you need a quick rollback. :+1:

sylvie: adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cpu-flood. also note: if redis queue backlog grows > 10k during the window escalate immediately.

arjun: thanks all. test plan: i'll trigger synthetic alert with curl to the alerting api in 5m, will post the payload and confirmation.

arjun: (test) curl -X POST https://alerts.redwood.dev/test -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"labels":{"priority":"low","env":"non-prod"},"metric":"cpu","value":72}'

ops-bot: Test alert received at 1752004100. Routed to #eng-oncall-delayed.

arjun: test confirmed. routing looks good. I'll apply at 06:00. kevin thanks for backup. sylvie i'll add the redis check to the deploy notes. :thumbsup:

maria: ack. will monitor dashboards from 06:00.

kevin: see you on standby.

arjun: done — change applied at 06:00 UTC. keeping watch. will post if any weirdness. :rotating_light:
